# BIO 150L — General Biology Laboratory

Instructor: Dr. Hyrum Young
Meets: W 13:00-16:00, Life Sciences 204
Term: Winter 2027
Start: 2027-01-11
End: 2027-04-23

## Learning Outcomes

Record observations in a lab notebook using standard conventions.
Apply aseptic technique without contaminating a culture.
Interpret gel electrophoresis results and explain each band.
Write a lab report that states a testable hypothesis and a conclusion.

## Policies

Safety: goggles and closed-toe shoes are required in the lab at all times.
Attendance: a missed lab cannot be made up without documented approval.
Academic integrity: lab reports must report your own measurements.
Collaboration: data collection is shared; analysis and writing are individual.
